'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The largest [[humanitarian aid]] [[airdrop]] since the war began takes place over the northern [[Gaza Strip]], with at least 14 aircraft from nine nations taking part in the operation. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-68774923 (BBC News)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Six police officers are killed and two more injured during an [[ambush]] by [[Jaish ul-Adl]] gunmen in [[Sistan and Baluchestan province|Sistan and Baluchestan]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-clashes-policemen-killed-c91115ce20232b757f0397705497b981?utm_source=RecoReel&utm_medium=articlePage&utm_id=Taboola (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**Heavy fighting and clashes occur between the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and the [[Rapid Support Forces]] (RSF) in areas controlled by the RSF primarily near [[Wad Madani]] in [[Gezira State]]. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/violent-battles-and-aerial-bombardment-reported-in-el-gezira (Dabanga Sudan)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Israel–Turkey relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Trade (Turkey)|Turkish Trade Ministry]] announces that it will suspend the export of 54 categories of goods to [[Israel]] in response to Israel banning [[Turkey]] from participating in humanitarian air drops over the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/4/9/turkey-restricts-exports-of-54-products-to-israel-until-gaza-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020–2024 H5N1 outbreak]]
**A [[Federation University Australia]] expedition confirms that [[avian influenza|bird flu]] is currently spreading across [[Antarctica]], with outbreaks confirmed in wild bird populations in [[Beak Island]], [[Hope Bay, Antarctica|Hope Bay]], [[Devil Island]], and [[Paulet Island]]. [https://english.elpais.com/science-tech/2024-04-09/scientists-discover-massive-outbreak-of-deadly-bird-flu-in-antarctica.html (''El Pais'')]
*[[2024 Lake Suviana explosion]]
**Three people are killed, five are injured and four are missing in an explosion at a power plant on Lake Suviana, near [[Bologna]], [[Italy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-explosion-hydroelectric-plant-9bad887184d623bf7cf828fc03b5df53 (AP)]
*[[2024 Mozambique boat disaster]]
**The death toll from Sunday's ferry sinking in [[Mozambique]] increases to more than 100 people, with around 20 people still missing. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2516057-dodental-scheepsramp-mozambique-opgelopen-tot-boven-100 (NOS)]
*[[Orsk Dam collapse]]
**More than 100,000 people in [[Russia]] and [[Kazakhstan]] are ordered to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] amid catastrophic [[flood]]ing along the [[Ural (river)|Ural river]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/thousands-people-risk-floods-hit-russias-south-2024-04-09/ (Reuters)]
*The [[United Nations]]' [[International Organization for Migration]] reports that 38 people died when a boat, which has carried around 66 [[Ethiopians|Ethiopian]] migrants, has sank off Godoria, [[Djibouti]], a day before while on its way to [[Yemen]]. At least six more are still missing and presumed dead. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/africa/article/3258423/least-38-migrants-including-children-die-shipwreck-djibouti-horn-africa-un-migration-agency-says (AFP via ''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**The [[Arizona Supreme Court]] upholds a law criminalizing most types of [[abortions]] in the case ''[[Planned Parenthood Arizona v. Mayes]]''. [https://theguardian.com/us-news/2024/apr/09/arizona-supreme-court-abortion-decision (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Iceland]]
**Icelandic Minister of Foreign Affairs [[Bjarni Benediktsson (born 1970)|Bjarni Benediktsson]] is appointed [[Prime Minister of Iceland|Prime Minister]] after [[Katrín Jakobsdóttir]]'s resignation on 5 April. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/10/iceland-conservative-foreign-minister-replaces-jakobsdottir-as-pm (The Guardian)]
